verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud's product page names a built-in "Grafana Assistant" and "Investigations" among its AI-powered capabilities and promises natural-language understanding of production systems, so a first-party in-product assistant exists. The evidence is only marketing-level mentions; nothing documents which tasks can be delegated or how. The MCP server evidence covers external agents connecting to Grafana and is not credited here. Missing for 10: documentation of what tasks the Assistant can perform or execute (e.g., building dashboards, writing queries, running investigations), detail on agentic delegation versus Q&A, availability outside Grafana Cloud, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Includes AI-powered capabilities for engineering teams, including Grafana Assistant, Investigations, Agent Observability, and more.
Understand production systems faster using natural language
